frozen_gates.criterion: every returned order/factor exactly certified; no false factor
GEMINI total work beats best successful single constituent on >=25% of fresh cases
median GEMINI total work / min(BSGS,rho-like strong baseline work) <= 1.0 on comparable fresh cases
peak stored residues/table entries reported for every solver
GEMINI total work includes relation scout + orbit + early factor + verification work actually spent
report fitted log2(work) slope by input bit; informational only, never asymptotic proof

success_rule: All exactness/accounting gates must pass. Performance hypothesis requires G2 and G3 simultaneously. Otherwise preserve negative result.
polynomial_time_boundary: Finite scale-ladder success cannot establish polynomial-time factoring. A polynomial-time claim requires a formal worst-case poly(log N) bit-complexity proof including both cores, routing, verification, memory, and intermediate representations.
